post.summary: Join a team with an access code
post.description: Requires assent. A retry by the same patient returns 200 with the existing membership rather than reporting the code as already used.
The server picks the window from the team's fixtures and returns the whole instrument, so the wording is never duplicated in the client.
Scores the run, stores the sections and routes the result to the school's providers. Idempotent.

Opens a fresh attempt at the same window and returns it exactly as starting one does. The earlier attempt is kept and stays readable by the providers it was routed to. 409 SCREENING_NOT_SUBMITTED if the run is still open, and 409 SCREENING_WINDOW_CLOSED once the window has moved on. If an attempt is already open for the window, that one is returned instead.
Records that the student opened care for this run, so the board steps aside.
